declared: 2026-11-13, before any study result was computed
scope: LOCAL SCALED-DOWN study on an Apple M4 laptop (10 cores, 16 GB). The user chose local compute over a paid GPU instance. Scaling choice: every model is trained on the 100 development days immediately before its validation window (rolling window) instead of the full expanding history; all 200 stocks and complete timestamp cross-sections are kept. Results are labelled 'local-100d' and are not full-data results.

days.terminal_holdout_status: REUSED: already evaluated once in full-v3. Never used for any selection here. Evaluated at most once more, for the single frozen final candidate, and reported as reused, not pristine.
days.fresh_external_test: none available; Kaggle's later private data are not accessible offline

windows.train_rule: fit on days [start-101, start-2]: the 100 days ending one gap day before the window
windows.nested_rule: For outer window Wk, a configuration is selected using only the mean daily MAE on windows W1..W(k-1), each scored by a model trained strictly before that window. All selection information therefore predates Wk. The outer score of that selected configuration on Wk is the performance estimate.

selection_metric: mean MAE over the pooled rows of the selection windows (basis points); ties broken by lower complexity order in the candidate list

stock_holdout.rule: 40 stocks drawn with numpy default_rng(2026).choice(200, 40, replace=False); these stocks' rows are removed from training in the unseen-stock experiment and used as its evaluation rows

excluded_from_predictors: stock_id (category: used only by Ridge one-hot and neural identity)

ablation.leave_one_group_out: each of the 8 groups removed from all features
ablation.permutation: XGBoost all-features model; on each validation window, the columns of one group are permuted jointly across rows within the same date_id (same permutation for all columns of the group), 3 repeats; importance = MAE increase. Rows within a day are dependent and features are correlated across groups, so this measures reliance of the fitted model, not causal value.

search.screening: none: every candidate is evaluated on all declared windows

neural_common.note: early stopping uses the last 15% of each fitting period only

random_forest_sensitivity.note: bootstrap-fraction sensitivity only (one window, compute); not a selection candidate

ensembles.members: per outer window, the family-best configuration of each of ridge, random_forest, xgboost, lstm (selected on earlier windows)
candidates: nonnegative weights summing to 1, fitted to minimise MAE on earlier windows' out-of-fold predictions
xgboost + constant bias fitted on earlier windows
xgboost with per-timestamp cross-sectional centering (tested, not assumed)
ensembles.rule: all weights/calibration learned on windows before the outer window, then frozen

statistics.unit: paired daily mean loss difference (whole cross-sections resampled together)
tests: moving-block bootstrap with block lengths 2, 5, 10 days
Diebold-Mariano style mean test with Newey-West HAC standard error (lag 5)
statistics.multiple_comparisons: Holm correction across the declared confirmatory family: (a) final vs zero, (b) xgboost vs ridge, (c) xgboost vs lstm, (d) xgboost vs random_forest, (e) lstm embedding vs no identity, (f) all features vs leave-out of the most important group; all other comparisons are exploratory
statistics.regimes: high/low volatility days defined by the median across development days of the cross-sectional mean of |wap_diff1| at seconds_in_bucket <= 300 (observable before most targets); earlier vs later = W1-W2 vs W4-W5

final.rule: Among single configurations and equal-weight blends of fixed family-best configurations (all scored on W1..W5 with models trained before each window), pick the lowest mean MAE over W1..W5. A learned-weight or calibrated blend may be chosen only if it beat equal weighting in the nested outer evaluation (W3..W5). The frozen choice is retrained on days 360..459 (gap day 460) and evaluated once on the REUSED terminal holdout 461..480.

compute.host: Apple M4, 10 cores, 16 GB, macOS; CPU only (MPS LSTM measured 2.6x slower than CPU for this model)
compute.queues: tree/linear queue with 6 threads and neural queue with 4 torch threads run concurrently
compute.pre_freeze_benchmarks: before this protocol was frozen, four timing fits were run on W1 (ridge alpha 100, xgboost v3, random forest v3, 1-epoch LSTM). Their W1 scores were visible; they were deleted and are not used. The RF grid was reduced to fit the compute budget after timing, not after comparing scores.
